decision: Do not promote the public-data localizers as new-proposal supplements
evidence: Both public-admit seeds recover six additional blue targets on the 67-frame panel (65TP versus59), but false positives rise from13 to30 and37.
62-frame public-admit results are57TP/46FP/10FN and60TP/48FP/7FN, versus51/25/16 baseline. Precision remains far below the target.
Controls are sample-count and optimizer-step matched, not annotation-count matched. Public examples do not show a consistent benefit over these controls.
The new public boxes are difficult even in TRAIN: learned blue coverage is5/18 and2/18, red2/12 for both seeds. More data alone has not resolved localization.
All four exports preserve the 2342-parameter architecture and are14420 bytes, with decoded parity on129 frames. No Pi performance claim follows.
next_experiment: Evaluate a fixed, TRAIN-first geometry refinement policy that can shrink already accepted blue boxes using nearby high-confidence learned boxes. Do not add detections, change classes, change red boxes or add classifier calls. Require retained known TRAIN detections before considering development evaluation.
